variants.headline: Still in view: government cannot pay its debts
variants.sub: The colony's government is unable to pay its debts.
variants.body:
The government of {colony} cannot pay its debts. Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement.

Workers have reason to take public debts seriously without accepting that every burden belongs on their shoulders. Labour finds the stewardship of {target} wanting; ordinary people deserve a more responsible standard of conduct.
